coordinateFrameExpectation.basis: Linked Central Mississippi Work Unit 4 bare-earth DEM metadata describes these project settings. This is a hypothesis for the LAZ header, not proof of the exact tile header.

limitations: A source-catalog bounding box intersecting the capture point does not prove the specific building has sufficient point returns.
No point-cloud file SHA-256 is supplied by the TNM catalog; the first verified download will capture an observed hash, then the source manifest will pin it for repeatability.
The linked work-unit DEM is bare-earth, so it is not a building roof/facade reference. This manifest targets the separate LAZ tile.
No candidate GLB, GPS-to-COLMAP transform, survey control points or held-out geometry metrics have been produced.
A header that declares a compatible CRS still requires an explicit metric frame registration and independent held-out checks before any accuracy claim.
